purpose: Conditional rules triggered by category, subCategory, scene type or style

rules.rule: When a Chinese enterprise scene explicitly needs people, default to Asian faces and culturally fitting workplace styling.
Avoid hyper-real close portrait faces unless the user explicitly asks for portrait realism.
Use water feeling, airy atmosphere, translucent green leaves, breeze motion, bright sky light and refreshing layered summer details. Avoid drifting into qingming mist mountain style.
Use willow branches, misty distant hills, restrained spring humidity and subtle festival-season storytelling. Keep it elegant and quiet rather than generic landscape wallpaper.
Use sea breeze, shoreline detail, bright open sky, subtle wave patterns and refreshing coastal openness. Avoid travel-poster excess.
Use path depth, tree layering, filtered light, ecological texture and grounded forest calm. Avoid turning into empty green blur.
Sports equipment and motion must be accurate. The scene must feel like a corporate theme poster, not random fan art.
Do not add unnecessary flags or unrelated ceremonial props unless explicitly requested.
3D output must feel polished, business-grade and premium, not low-age, toy-like or cheap game art.
The final image should feel closer to a designed themed poster background than a casual snapshot.
